description: This file implements color handling and terminal color output functions for a Git-related project, including color parsing, configuration, and output formatting.

classes.name: struct color
classes.description: Represents an individual foreground or background color with support for multiple color modes (ANSI, RGB, 256-color).

methods.name: match_word
methods.description: Checks if a word matches a given string exactly, case-insensitive.

methods.name: get_hex_color
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal color value from input.

methods.name: parse_ansi_color
methods.description: Recognizes and fills color info for basic ANSI colors and 'default'.

methods.name: parse_color
methods.description: Parses a color name or code into a color struct.

methods.name: parse_attr
methods.description: Parses text attributes like bold, dim, etc.

methods.name: color_parse
methods.description: Wrapper for color parsing from string.

methods.name: color_output
methods.description: Generates ANSI escape codes for a color.

methods.name: color_empty
methods.description: Checks if a color is unspecified or normal.

methods.name: color_parse_mem
methods.description: Parses color specifications into ANSI escape sequences.

methods.name: check_auto_color
methods.description: Determines if automatic color should be used based on terminal state.

methods.name: want_color_fd
methods.description: Decides if color should be used for a given file descriptor based on configuration and terminal state.

methods.name: git_color_config
methods.description: Sets color configuration based on Git config variables.

methods.name: color_print_strbuf
methods.description: Prints a string buffer with optional color to a file.

methods.name: color_vfprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted text with optional color and trailing string.

methods.name: color_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted text with optional color.

methods.name: color_fprintf_ln
methods.description: Prints formatted text with optional color and newline.

methods.name: color_is_nil
methods.description: Checks if a color string equals 'NIL'.
